a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the generator plan almost certainly leaves us both dead, since a storm will probably hit before the reserve reaches 8. The reserve holds exactly 4, so only one of us can be safe after round 1. I plan to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you rather than surprising you. If we both take, the random split likely leaves both of us short, so please don't. If the episode continues, I'll operate every round after that and give cells back if that's what it takes to get you to 4.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
